summary: Refactored Pi global resource handling so discovered skills carry an `editable` flag, gated read/write/UI edit actions on that flag, replaced string-based skill path matching with `realpath`/`lstat` for Windows-safe comparisons, and updated tests plus docs/checks accordingly.
decisions: Discovered skills expose an `editable` flag; `readManagedSkill`/`writeManagedSkill` and the skill edit UI use it to restrict access to non-adopted Pi resources.
Path comparisons for skill containment now resolve real paths (`realpath`/`lstat`) instead of raw strings, to handle Windows case and symlink differences.
`DefaultResourceLoader` and `createAgentSession` were dropped from `createDefaultPiSession`, with service initialization consolidated around `createAgentSessionFromServices`.
Tests assert `toContain('pi-only')` / `toContain('review')` rather than exact arrays, since user-global Pi skills (e.g. `impeccable`) leak into the discovery list.
errors: Edit attempt against `pi-agent-service.ts` failed because the `oldText` whitespace didn't match; re-read the file and reapplied with corrected indentation.
`pnpm check` failed with `TS2741: Property 'editable' is missing` in `tests/resources/resource-catalog.test.ts`; resolved by making `editable` optional in `DiscoveredSkill`.
Vitest reported 20 failures because tests expected only project/global resources while Pi's user agent directory leaked `impeccable`, `archify`, etc.; adjusted assertions to use `toContain`.
